			state = { activate_production_method = { building_type = building_silk_plantation production_method = pm_no_private_ownership_agricultural_stock } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { is_building_type = building_vineyard }
			state = { activate_production_method = { building_type = building_vineyard production_method = pm_no_private_ownership_agricultural_stock } }
		}
		owner = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_modifier = has_financial_center }
				financial_center_production_methods = yes
			}
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			has_active_production_method = pm_no_private_ownership_mining_stock
			private_ownership_fraction > 0.5
			or = {
				is_building_type = building_coal_mine
				is_building_type = building_iron_mine
				is_building_type = building_lead_mine
				is_building_type = building_sulfur_mine
				is_building_type = building_gold_mine
				is_building_type = building_silver_mine
				is_building_type = building_oil_rig
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { is_building_type = building_coal_mine }
			state = { activate_production_method = { building_type = building_coal_mine production_method = pm_private_ownership_majority_mining_stock } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { is_building_type = building_iron_mine }
			state = { activate_production_method = { building_type = building_iron_mine production_method = pm_private_ownership_majority_mining_stock } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { is_building_type = building_lead_mine }
			state = { activate_production_method = { building_type = building_lead_mine production_method = pm_private_ownership_majority_mining_stock } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { is_building_type = building_sulfur_mine }
			state = { activate_production_method = { building_type = building_sulfur_mine production_method = pm_private_ownership_majority_mining_stock } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { is_building_type = building_gold_mine }
			state = { activate_production_method = { building_type = building_gold_mine production_method = pm_private_ownership_majority_mining_stock } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { is_building_type = building_silver_mine }
			state = { activate_production_method = { building_type = building_silver_mine production_method = pm_private_ownership_majority_mining_stock } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { is_building_type = building_oil_rig }
			state = { activate_production_method = { building_type = building_oil_rig production_method = pm_private_ownership_majority_mining_stock } }
		}
		owner = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_modifier = has_financial_center }
				financial_center_production_methods = yes
			}
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			has_active_production_method = pm_private_ownership_majority_mining_stock
			private_ownership_fraction <= 0.5
			or = {
				is_building_type = building_coal_mine
				is_building_type = building_iron_mine
				is_building_type = building_lead_mine
				is_building_type = building_sulfur_mine
				is_building_type = building_gold_mine
				is_building_type = building_silver_mine
				is_building_type = building_oil_rig
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { is_building_type = building_coal_mine }
			state = { activate_production_method = { building_type = building_coal_mine production_method = pm_no_private_ownership_mining_stock } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { is_building_type = building_iron_mine }
			state = { activate_production_method = { building_type = building_iron_mine production_method = pm_no_private_ownership_mining_stock } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { is_building_type = building_lead_mine }
			state = { activate_production_method = { building_type = building_lead_mine production_method = pm_no_private_ownership_mining_stock } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { is_building_type = building_sulfur_mine }
			state = { activate_production_method = { building_type = building_sulfur_mine production_method = pm_no_private_ownership_mining_stock } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { is_building_type = building_gold_mine }
			state = { activate_production_method = { building_type = building_gold_mine production_method = pm_no_private_ownership_mining_stock } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { is_building_type = building_silver_mine }
			state = { activate_production_method = { building_type = building_silver_mine production_method = pm_no_private_ownership_mining_stock } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { is_building_type = building_oil_rig }
			state = { activate_production_method = { building_type = building_oil_rig production_method = pm_no_private_ownership_mining_stock } }
		}
		owner = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_modifier = has_financial_center }
				financial_center_production_methods = yes
			}
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			has_active_production_method = pm_no_private_ownership_railroad_stock
			private_ownership_fraction > 0.5
			or = {
				is_building_type = building_railway
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { is_building_type = building_railway }
			state = { activate_production_method = { building_type = building_railway production_method = pm_private_ownership_majority_railroad_stock } }
		}
		owner = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_modifier = has_financial_center }
				financial_center_production_methods = yes
			}
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			has_active_production_method = pm_private_ownership_majority_railroad_stock
			private_ownership_fraction <= 0.5
			or = {
				is_building_type = building_railway
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { is_building_type = building_railway }
			state = { activate_production_method = { building_type = building_railway production_method = pm_no_private_ownership_railroad_stock } }
		}
		owner = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_modifier = has_financial_center }
				financial_center_production_methods = yes
			}
		}
	}
}
